verdict.rationale: The evidence offers only indirect building blocks. Make documents cloning a scenario and a 'scenario history' page, though it is unclear whether that history means versions or execution runs. Its REST API, TypeScript SDK and MCP server can view and modify scenarios, which could be scripted into a manual dev-to-prod copy workflow. Missing for 10: native source-control/Git integration, defined dev/staging/production environments, a documented promotion or deployment mechanism, clear evidence of scenario version history with rollback, and independent corroboration.
